reference_commit: MOM6 dev/ncar_260909 @301879336 (ESCOMP fork, submodule mi_260909) + instrument/mom6-dumps 9955b6b31 (MOM6/src) / e7b257e (components/mom) / 80a179b (superproject)
description: MOM6 boundary traces from an instrumented C_JRA_t62 run (PLAN.md MOM6 lane, stage-1), default-off and enabled in this run only via MOM_override params read by mom6_dump_mod (DUMP_MOM6, DUMP_DIR, DUMP_FIRST_CELLS, DUMP_FIRST_STEPS); module mom6_dump_mod.F90 lives in MOM6/src/framework and is always compiled, with dump calls gated at runtime by dump_pet .and. is_init .and. dump_cpl_step <= dump_first_steps: (a) EOS law - Wright 1997 full-range in-situ density rho(T,S,p) and analytic first derivatives drho/dT, drho/dS (MOM_EOS_Wright_full density_elem / calculate_density_derivs_elem, constants MOM_EOS_Wright_full.F90:24-38), one row per (cell, layer, diabatic step) inside KPP_compute_BLD; (b) KPP boundary layer - the CVMix KPP OBL computation inputs/outputs (pre-smoothing OBLdepth, kOBL, BulkRi_1d, deltaU2, deltaT2, deltaS2, N2_1d, surfBuoyFlux, h, p_surf) and the full KPP_calculate result (Kt/Ks/Kv_in pre-KPP, CVMix Kdiffusivity/Kviscosity Kd_heat/Kd_salt/Kv, Kt/Ks/Kv_out final, nonlocal NLT_heat/NLT_salt, OBLdepth smoothed, kOBL, surfBuoyFlux, z_inter, z_cell), one row per (cell, step); (c) surface forcing - the 25 imported ice-ocean boundary fields (x_in gather in update_ocean_model) and the convert_IOB_to_fluxes/forces outputs (latent/sw/evap/lprec/fprec/salt_flux/seaice_melt etc.) plus the forces (taux/tauy/tau_mag_o/ustar_o/omega_w2x/p_surf_full), one row per (cell, coupling step).

regenerate.command: source stage1/runs/env.sh && python3 stage1/EqESM-cesm-mom6/cime/scripts/create_newcase --case stage1/cime/cases/C_JRA_t62_mom6_inst --compset C_JRA --res T62_t232 --machine illinois --project ctessum --run-unsupported --srcroot stage1/EqESM-cesm-mom6 && cd stage1/cime/cases/C_JRA_t62_mom6_inst && ./xmlchange STOP_OPTION=ndays,STOP_N=1,REST_OPTION=ndays,REST_N=1,RUN_STARTDATE=0001-01-01,TOTALPES=72,NTASKS_ATM=36,NTASKS_OCN=36,NTASKS_ICE=36,NTASKS_CPL=36 && ./case.setup && ./case.build && env -u SLURM_MEM_PER_NODE -u SLURM_MEM_PER_CPU -u SLURM_MEM_PER_GPU ./case.submit
regenerate.note: Model source root is the fork worktree stage1/EqESM-cesm-mom6 (branch instrument/mom6-dumps; MOM6 submodule @9955b6b31, all other submodules at their pristine pins - cime 6.7.1, FMS fi_260310, parallelio pio2_6_8, MARBL 0.50.3 - untouched); the fork's own cime/scripts/create_newcase is used with --srcroot pointing at the fork. Dump CSVs land in stage1/dumps/mom6/ (DUMP_DIR in user_nl_mom). Full dumps are gitignored and regenerable; the run takes ~8 min wall.

run.result: COMPLETED 0:0 (7:43 wall; runs 1 and 2 superseded - run 1 used an uncommitted dump writer with broken filenames, run 2 exposed the uninitialized LangEnhK denormal, both fixed in the fork and both solution-neutral anyway)
run.compset: C_JRA (C: atm+ocn+ice+land+glc+rof+esp; datm JRA-1hr, ocn MOM6, ice CICE5, lnd CLM, rof MOSART, glc Stieglitz)
run.grid: T62_t232 (tx2_3v2 2-deg ocean, NIGLOBAL=540 x NJGLOBAL=480, NK=75 z* layers)
run.dates: start 0001-01-01, STOP_OPTION=ndays STOP_N=1 (one day), REST_OPTION=ndays REST_N=1
run.coupling: ATM/OCN/ICE_NCPL=24 (coupling dt=3600 s), MOM DT=1800 s, DT_THERM=3600 s, THERMO_SPANS_COUPLING=False (one diabatic/KPP call per coupling interval; 24 intervals per day)
run.pes: TOTALPES=72 on 2 nodes (NTASKS_ATM/OCN/ICE/CPL=36, mirrored from the reference C_JRA_t62 run); dumps from PET 0 only
run.precision: real64 everywhere (CESM default); all MOM6 rescale factors 1.0 so internal units == MKS

namelist_deltas.user_nl_mom: AUTO_MASKTABLE = False (inherited from reference), DUMP_MOM6 = True, DUMP_DIR = /projects/illinois/eng/cee/ctessum/ctessum/code/EqESM/stage1/dumps/mom6, DUMP_FIRST_CELLS = 32, DUMP_FIRST_STEPS = 12
namelist_deltas.note: All other settings identical to the reference run C_JRA_t62 (EOS WRIGHT_FULL, TFREEZE LINEAR, USE_KPP=True with MatchGradient/LMD94 interp/N_SMOOTH=3/KPP_IS_ADDITIVE=False/NLT_SHAPE=CVMix/COMPUTE_MONIN_OBUKHOV=True/MXL_SW, USE_LMD94, STOCH_EOS=True perturbs only the pressure-gradient force so the EOS law itself is deterministic, GUST_CONST=4.0e-4 Pa, LATENT_HEAT_FUSION=3.337e5, LATENT_HEAT_VAPORIZATION=2.501e6 J/kg, RHO_0=1035 kg m-3). Verified solution-neutral: the instrumented run's mom6/cpl/datm/dice/drof restarts and ocean.stats are bit-identical (modulo title/timestamp attributes) to the reference run (stage1/analysis/compare_mom6_restarts.py).

dump_files.mom6_eos.csv: cpl_step,ymd,tod,gi,gj,i,j,lon,lat,k,T,S,p,rho,drho_dT,drho_dS - Wright 1997 full-range in-situ density and analytic derivatives per (cell, layer, step), as computed by KPP_compute_BLD's calculate_density/calculate_density_derivs_scalar (MOM_EOS_Wright_full.F90 density_elem/calculate_density_derivs_elem; MKS, EOS scale factors 1.0); T potential temp [degC], S salinity [psu], p [Pa] the pressure at the top interface of layer k (surface pressure + hydrostatic weight of the layers above, MOM_CVMix_KPP.F90:1428-1440)
dump_files.mom6_kpp_obl.csv: cpl_step,ymd,tod,gi,gj,i,j,lon,lat,uStar,Coriolis,p_surf,OBLdepth,kOBL,buoyFlux_01..76,T_01..75,S_01..75,U_H_01..75,V_H_01..75,h_01..75,dz_01..75,N2_01..76,BulkRi_01..75,deltaU2_01..75,z_cell_01..75,z_inter_01..76 - CVMix KPP OBL inputs/outputs from KPP_compute_BLD before smoothing (OBLdepth raw but bounds-clamped no-shallower-than-top-layer/no-deeper-than-bottom-offset, kOBL fractional level, surface buoyancy flux profile, bulk Richardson numbers, surface-layer shear squared, N2 on interfaces, layer thicknesses/heights, surface pressure, interface/cell heights); N2 has ke+1=76 entries
dump_files.mom6_kpp.csv: cpl_step,ymd,tod,gi,gj,i,j,lon,lat,OBLdepth,kOBL,uStar,surfBuoyFlux,La_SL,LangEnhK,z_inter_01..76,Kd_heat_01..76,Kd_salt_01..76,Kv_01..76,NLT_heat_01..76,NLT_salt_01..76,Kt_in_01..76,Ks_in_01..76,Kv_in_01..76,Kt_out_01..76,Ks_out_01..76,Kv_out_01..76 - CVMix KPP_calculate result per interface k: interior diffusivities captured at column entry (Kt/Ks/Kv_in, MOM_CVMix_KPP.F90:825), CVMix Kdiffusivity/Kviscosity (Kd_heat/Kd_salt/Kv), final Kt/Ks/Kv_out after the KPP_IS_ADDITIVE=False update (Kt_out = Kd_heat where Kd_heat/=0 else Kt_in, etc.), NLT_heat/NLT_salt nonlocal transports, OBLdepth smoothed (N_SMOOTH=3), La_SL/LangEnhK (Langmuir diag; inert in this run)
dump_files.mom6_sfc_forcing.csv: cpl_step,ymd,tod,gi,gj,i,j,lon,lat,p,sw_vis_dir,sw_vis_dif,sw_nir_dir,sw_nir_dif,lw_flux,t_flux,q_flux,lprec,fprec,lrunoff,frunoff,hrain,hsnow,hrofl,hrofi,hevap,hcond,u_flux,v_flux,salt_flux,seaice_melt_heat,seaice_melt,ice_fraction,u10_sqr,sw,sw_vis_dir_o,sw_vis_dif_o,sw_nir_dir_o,sw_nir_dif_o,lw,latent,sens,seaice_melt_heat_o,heat_added,evap,lprec_o,fprec_o,vprec,lrunoff_o,frunoff_o,lrunoff_glc,frunoff_glc,seaice_melt_o,salt_flux_o,salt_flux_in,p_surf_full,ustar,tau_mag,ice_fraction_o,u10_sqr_o,heat_content_cond,heat_content_evap,heat_content_lprec,heat_content_fprec,heat_content_lrunoff,heat_content_frunoff,latent_evap_diag,latent_fprec_diag,latent_frunoff_diag,taux,tauy,tau_mag_o,ustar_o,p_surf_full_o,omega_w2x,net_mass_src - 25 imported IOB fields (first 25, as gathered in update_ocean_model) plus convert_IOB_to_fluxes/forces outputs per (cell, coupling step); all unit conversions are 1.0 in this run so imported and exported values are directly comparable
dump_files.mom6_sfc_forcing_dims: 67 value columns per row (25 IOB + 35 fluxes + 7 forces), as listed above

traced_domain.cells: all 12 ocean cells of PET 0 (dump_first_cells=32 requested; PET 0 is the SW corner block of the 6x6 decomposition and only 12 of its cells are ocean - the 77 southernmost grid rows are Antarctic land mask), in (j,i) loop order; gi/gj are the global indices
traced_domain.steps: dump_first_steps=12 traced coupling steps of the 24-step day, with the CESM startup ocean-lag (mom_cap.F90:1835-1856: the first coupling timestep is skipped and the second call steps back one interval and advances by two): the forcing dump fired 12 times (OS%Time tods 0, 7200..43200; the first is the lag call at cap-time 3600 whose OS%Time is still 0; there is no dump row at cap-time 3600), and the KPP dumps fired on all 13 thermo steps covered (Time_end tods 3600..46800; cpl_step 1 appears twice - the first advance covers two thermo steps with the same forcing)
traced_domain.steps_note: eos has 12 x 75 x 13 = 11700 rows (all layers of the 13 traced thermo steps); kpp_obl and kpp have 12 x 13 = 156 rows each; sfc_forcing has 12 x 12 = 144 rows. KPP dumps fire once per (cell, thermo step) from MOM_diabatic_driver (one per coupling interval since DT_THERM = coupling dt); the dump_cpl_step counter is shared, incremented once per coupling interval by the forcing dump (the first traced cell of the interval).

checks.bit_identical_outputs: instrumented run mom6.r/mom6.r_stoch/cpl.r/datm.r/dice.r/drof.r restarts and ocean.stats differ from the reference C_JRA_t62 run only in title/timestamp attributes - all data variables identical, so the dump code changes nothing when enabled (stage1/analysis/compare_mom6_restarts.py)
checks.eos_law: rho = (p+p0)/(lambda + al0*(p+p0)) with al0 = a0+(a1*T+a2*S), p0 = b0+(b4*S+T*(b1+(T*(b2+b3*T)+b5*S))), lambda = c0+(c4*S+T*(c1+(T*(c2+c3*T)+c5*S))) and the analytic drho/dT, drho/dS (MOM_EOS_Wright_full.F90:24-38 constants) hold to round-off on all 11700 rows (Python reimplementation mirrors the Fortran operation order exactly)
checks.hydrostatic_pressure: p_{k+1} - p_k = g*H_to_RZ * h_k with a constant dp/dh ratio across all layers/cells/steps (Boussinesq pRef accumulation in KPP_compute_BLD)
checks.kpp_update_law: with KPP_IS_ADDITIVE=False: Kt_out = Kd_heat where Kd_heat/=0 else Kt_in (same for Ks_out/Kd_salt/Ks_in and Kv_out/Kv/Kv_in) on all 156x76 interfaces
checks.kpp_nlt_law: NLT_heat == NLT_salt everywhere; NLT = 0 at the surface interface (k=1) and everywhere surfBuoyFlux >= 0, on all 156 columns. All traced columns happen to be stably stratified (surfBuoyFlux >= 0), so the CVMix NLT_SHAPE branch for unstable columns (NLT_k/(sigma_k*(1-sigma_k)^2) constant) is not exercised by this trace
checks.kpp_obl_law: kbl = int(kOBL) in [1,ke] (ke+1 only when the OBL reaches the bottom clamp), fractional part in [0,1), and -OBLdepth bracketed by the interface pair around kOBL on all 156 columns; OBLdepth > 0, kOBL >= 1; z_inter identical between the OBL and KPP dumps for the same (cell, step)
checks.forcing_law: latent = q_flux*Lv - fprec*Lf - frunoff*Lf - frunoff_glc*Lf, latent_evap_diag = q_flux*Lv, latent_fprec_diag = -fprec*Lf, latent_frunoff_diag = -frunoff*Lf (Lv=2.501e6, Lf=3.337e5 J/kg); sw = sw_vis_dir+sw_vis_dif+sw_nir_dir+sw_nir_dif; evap = q_flux; lprec_o/fprec_o/lrunoff_o/frunoff_o/seaice_melt_o/seaice_melt_heat_o/ice_fraction_o = the imported values (conversions 1.0); p_surf_full = p and p_surf_full_o = p; tau_mag_o = GUST_CONST + sqrt(u_flux^2+v_flux^2) (GUST_CONST=4.0e-4 Pa; AGRID builds tau_mag from the imported u_flux/v_flux, mom_surface_forcing_nuopc.F90:956-959); ustar_o = sqrt((GUST_CONST+sqrt(u_flux^2+v_flux^2))/RHO_0) (RHO_0=1035); omega_w2x = atan2(v_flux,u_flux); salt_flux: with RESTORE_SALINITY=True the coupler import is copied into salt_flux_in by convert_IOB_to_fluxes (fluxes%salt_flux_in = mask*kg_m2_s_conversion*IOB%salt_flux, mom_surface_forcing_nuopc.F90:686-689) and added to the salinity-restoring flux in fluxes%salt_flux (salt_flux_o = salt_flux_in + restore); the mediator sends salt_flux = 0 in this run, so salt_flux_in == salt_flux == 0 on all 144 rows and salt_flux_o (4.90e-7..1.02e-6) is purely the restoring flux (SALT_RESTORE_FILE=state_restore_tx2_3_20230416.nc, ADJUST_NET_SRESTORE_TO_ZERO=True) - all on 144 rows
checks.row_counts: eos 12x75x13 = 11700 (13 thermo steps incl. the lag double-step); kpp_obl, kpp 12x13 = 156 each; sfc_forcing 12x12 = 144; zero blank lines in all 4 CSVs
